title: Smoked Salmon Puff Pastry Pinwheels
description: A twist on traditional pinwheels, these smoky salmon pinwheels are perfect for a quick appetizer or snack. Flaky puff pastry filled with smoked salmon and a hint of German seasoning.
instructions: Roll out puff pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
In a small bowl, mix together smoked salmon, anchovy fillets, and onion.
Spread the salmon mixture evenly over the center of the pastry, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Brush the edges with a little water and fold the pastry in half to enclose the filling.
Cut into pinwheels and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
